description: Partial exits against the live trailing exit, three designs

methodology.question: Do partial exits (part of each position sold at a profit target, the rest on the live trailing stop) improve on the live exit, and does it matter whether they are built as design 1 (shrink the stop), 2 (software targets) or 3 (per-tranche orders)?
methodology.baseline: trailing, evening raise only (what the routines do since #649); the bracket and the old trailing_target are references

plan.source: PartialExitManager defaults and from_mode_manager; trading_modes.yaml partial_exits
plan.first_target: limit sell at entry x (1 + target_1_pct)
plan.second_target: trailing: the rest keeps the trailing stop (no fixed price)

target_1_pct_run.T4: 0.04: PartialExitManager default and the value from_mode_manager hard-codes for every mode (what would be registered)
target_1_pct_run.T5: 0.05: trading_modes.yaml, moderate (the live mode); from_mode_manager does not read it

plan.whole_shares: first target int(n * 0.5) of n shares, the rest to the second; one share: no plan
plan.entry_reference: the fill (the open), before costs, as the stop and the bracket target use

designs.D1h: limit sell for the target shares, no stop on them; trailing stop on the others; limit fills on an intraday touch at the limit (open on a gap); if the stop shares are stopped out the target shares keep resting (until target, SELL signal or end of data), no stop
designs.D1x: as D1h, but the target shares are sold at the next open once the stop shares are gone (a routine finds a position with no stop)
designs.D2: every share has the trailing stop; the target is checked at the open (09:20 routine, open as proxy) and at the close (15:50 routine, close as proxy): at or past the target, the target shares sell at that price. No intraday fill. No open check on the entry day (bought at the open)
designs.D3: every share has the trailing stop (same levels); the target shares also a limit sell, one cancelling the other; limit fills on an intraday touch; a bar touching both counts as the stop (all shares, as live_rules_sim does for the bracket)

methodology.same_bar: stop first (conservative), as live_rules_sim._bracket_exit; counted in each run; the optimistic reading is a sensitivity (D3)
methodology.fills: stop touch at the stop price, gap at the open (shared with #539); limit touch at the limit price, gap above at the open; D2 at the open or close price; flat bps per side on every fill
methodology.slippage_sensitivity: 17 bps below the fill on gap-through-stop fills only, and on every stop fill; limit fills need the high 10 bps through the target

moderate.label: Moderate sizing (2% of equity), SELL-signal exits kept

conservative.label: Conservative sizing (1% of equity), SELL-signal exits kept

moderate_no_signal_exit.label: Moderate sizing, SELL-signal exits off (stops and targets only; matches live exits)

methodology.sharpe: annualized, rf 0; 95% circular block bootstrap (20-day blocks, 2000 reps)
methodology.paired_sharpe: Sharpe(a) - Sharpe(b) on the daily returns of the two equity curves; the same 20-day blocks are drawn for both in each of 2000 replications (seed 0); p is twice the smaller share of replications on one side of zero
methodology.paired_return_test: Newey-West test of the mean daily return difference (research_cli.paired_return_test); this is the test the multiple-testing audit collects
methodology.family: the 8 planned configurations against the baseline trailing exit, x 3 variants x 3 costs x 3 periods = 216 Newey-West tests (audit family). Design-against-design, against-bracket and sensitivity comparisons are reported, not in the family
methodology.trade_counting: a position is one trade (its legs combined, quantity-weighted); legs are the fills. Win rate, trades and mean return per trade are by position, comparable with the baseline's
methodology.turnover: (shares bought + shares sold) / 2 in dollars, per year, as a multiple of mean equity
not_modelled: deferral of raises on non-replaceable stop orders (live skips them until a later run; the sim lands every raise at once)

stale local entry_price across a split (a known live quirk: live tiers on a position held through a split use the pre-split cost; the sim uses the split-adjusted entry; a separate live-code issue could refresh entry_price from the broker)

the evening raise uses the 16:00 close where the live routine at 15:50 sees the 15:50 price: a ten-minute information advantage, Sharpe-level timing noise of about +/-0.04 that is not in the bootstrap interval
stop-market slippage beyond the flat cost: it hurts the trailing modes more than the bracket (see stop_fills)

the morning routine's raise from the pre-market price (09:20 ET): daily bars have no pre-market price, and on gap days it differs from the price of the evening raise; see morning_raise_sensitivity, which stands the day's open in for it
intraday timing of the raise (the stop is in force from the next session, not for the last ten minutes of the day)
intraday decisions (the CLI can also trade on a partial day)
GTC renewal after 80 days (assumed seamless, as #587 does it)
the 90-day lapse of the take-profit leg in trailing_target (the target is kept as in the bracket)
GTT sells (skipped while a broker stop holds the shares)
queue priority: a limit fills when the price touches it (sensitivity: needs 10 bps through)
partial fills, the 90-day GTC lapse of the limit orders, and Alpaca's rejection of a limit sell while a stop holds the shares (design 1 and 3 are what the designs would need to avoid it)
design 1's live behaviour for unprotected shares: the reconciler would try to re-place a stop and be refused while the limit holds the shares
the 09:20 and 15:50 routines run up to 5 minutes late; the open and close stand in for their prices
caveats: universe picked with hindsight; benchmark is buy-and-hold of the same symbols
MACD threshold is in dollars, so signal frequency depends on price level
the strategies share signals, not trades: a partial exit frees the position cap and cash earlier or later, so entries differ
no-edge entry signal (#574): this measures exits on a signal without demonstrated edge

same_bar_target_first.note: baseline for the paired difference: the main baseline run

slip_gap_only.note: baseline for the paired difference: the baseline run under the same slippage

slip_all_stops.note: baseline for the paired difference: the baseline run under the same slippage

limit_through_10bps.note: baseline for the paired difference: the main baseline run
